page.overview:
Who is Popemobile?

The Popemobile is a character in Cars 2. His job is to protect and transport Pope Pinion IV.

In Cars 2, the Popemobile transports Pope Pinion IV to see the 2nd World Grand Prix

Real world Popemobiles are typically based on a Mercedes-Benz 4x4 vehicle of the time. However, this Popemobile has to be much larger to transport a car.

According to his diecast, his license plate reads POPE MOBL (short for Popemobile).
